items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: I was playing the whole week with Rahsaan at the Vanguard playing tunes fast and with changes and everything

ctx.x: Did you think of him as eccentric at the time?

Yes. Because he was courageous. He was just like what I was saying about trying stuff. He would try stuff. Although I think he was probably one of the most adventurous or courageous guy out there in the music because he would try stuff. You know. He was always inventing something. And Rahsaan was like that you know. So I’ll tell you what, there was two things that Sun Ra said to me and he would always make sure that he challenged me. But one night we were playing at Slug’s and he knew that I could play changes…

out. Now I was expecting Sun Ra to say — you know smile — he just looked at me as if hmpf, okay, so what. And sit down at the piano. And he was saying, “I knew you could do it but you didn’t know you could do it.” That was the lesson.
